units.purpose: Provide strategic oversight, governance, accountability, and financial stewardship for the camp. The Camp Board ensures that the camp fulfils its spiritual objectives while operating safely, responsibly, and within approved budgets.
responsibilities: Define the overall vision and objectives of the camp.
Approve the camp budget and major expenditures.
Approve camp policies, operational plans, and risk management procedures.
Monitor the financial health of the camp.
Review procurement activities and ensure transparency.
Resolve major issues beyond the authority of the Camp Commandant.
Conduct the post-camp evaluation and approve recommendations for future camps.
authority: Approve budgets and emergency expenditures above approved limits.
Appoint or replace senior camp officials.

units.purpose: Provide overall leadership for the camp and ensure every department works together to deliver a safe, spiritually impactful and well-organized camp.
responsibilities: Present the final operational report to the Camp Board.
successMeasures: The camp programme runs on schedule.

units.purpose: Oversee every department directly responsible for the camper experience.
responsibilities: Ensure programmes run according to schedule.

tasks.title: Confirm readiness of all programme departments.

units.purpose: Manage the registration, check-in and check-out process while maintaining accurate camper records.

Escalate exceptional cases to the Deputy Camp Commandant.
